key_insight: The paper learns Koopman embeddings directly from data with a kernel-based bilevel optimization method, avoiding the need to hand-specify the dictionary.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable and more interpretable alternative to neural autoencoders for linearizing nonlinear dynamics in forecasting and system identification.
method: EDMD-kDL combines kernel dictionaries with extended dynamic mode decomposition.
A bilevel optimization scheme jointly learns the embedding and Koopman approximation.
Collocation points control kernel-matrix size, improving scalability to large datasets.
evidence_signal: Across tests including sea-surface-temperature forecasting and video-based learning, EDMD-kDL matched or outperformed state-of-the-art ANN autoencoder methods.
watch_item: Performance depends on the choice of kernel, collocation points, and optimization setup, so careful tuning and validation are needed.
paper_title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
